# Rusiru Rathmina

> Rusiru Rathmina is a Software Engineer focused on full-stack development and cloud solutions, delivering scalable applications with attention to quality.

## About Me

Hello! I'm Rusiru Rathmina, a Software Engineer at Omobio (Pvt) Ltd, specializing in Full-Stack Development, Cloud Computing, and DevOps.

My journey began as a trainee, and I have since grown into designing scalable solutions using Java, Spring Boot, React, and AWS. I have extensive hands-on experience refactoring legacy systems and building secure, reliable applications.

My expertise covers the full lifecycle—from frontend design with React.js to backend logic in PHP/Drupal and infrastructure management using Docker and Kubernetes.

I am always open to collaborating on Full-Stack or DevOps projects. Let's connect and shape the future of technology together!

## Work Experience

Software Engineer, Omobio (Pvt) Ltd, January 2026 - Present
Managed and supported cloud infrastructure, containerized applications, and orchestration workflows using AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes (K8s).
Successfully migrated Dialog.lk application images from end-of-life (EOL) Debian to Alpine Linux, reducing container image sizes by 60% and deployment time by 75%. Modernized legacy image build processes by implementing multi-stage builds to improve build efficiency, reduce image footprint, and strengthen security.
Implemented secure coding practices and contributed to application security initiatives aligned with OWASP best practices and ISO 27001 requirements.
Strengthened container and base image security by identifying and remediating CVE vulnerabilities, improving the overall security posture of applications and infrastructure.
Represented the development team in ISO 27001 compliance activities, security audits, and related processes, supporting adherence to organizational security standards.
Conducted peer code reviews and mentored new team members, promoting engineering best practices, code quality, and team productivity.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams in Agile environments to develop, maintain, and deliver scalable, high-quality, enterprise-grade software solutions.

## Featured Projects

- Dialog.lk: Played a key role in the development, maintenance, and production support of the Dialog.lk platform, handling complex L3 incidents, root cause analysis, and performance optimization while ensuring SLA compliance and meeting critical deadlines. Led efforts to refactor the legacy codebase in alignment with OWASP Top 10 security best practices, integrating SonarQube to improve code quality, identify vulnerabilities, and strengthen secure development practices. Developed custom Drupal modules integrating Amazon SES to replace SMTP-based email delivery, improving security and deliverability, and implemented user consent management capabilities to support compliance with Sri Lanka’s Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA). Identified and remediated security hotspots, code vulnerabilities, and CVE-related issues across the application and container images, strengthening the overall security posture and supporting ISO 27001 compliance activities. Migrated Dialog.lk application container images from end-of-life Debian to Alpine Linux, achieving a 60% reduction in image size and a 75% improvement in deployment time. Modernized legacy image build processes using multi-stage builds to improve efficiency and security. Optimized application performance and scalability using AWS services, including S3, SES, and CloudWatch, alongside caching mechanisms to improve operational efficiency and reliability. Contributed to CI/CD pipeline management, release coordination, and DevOps initiatives, supporting reliable deployments and streamlined development workflows.
- Dialog BizCare: Acted as a Level 3 (L3) support engineer, fixing bugs and handling live production issues within defined SLAs. Investigated production issues by analyzing server logs and implemented effective solutions to ensure system stability. Collaborated directly with clients and end-users to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve issues efficiently. Worked closely with senior engineers while following Agile development methodologies, coding standards, and software engineering best practices.
- MockDeck — API Mocking & Integration Testing Platform: Designed and developed MockDeck, an API mocking platform that helps developers and QA teams simulate API behavior, test integrations, and reproduce failure scenarios without depending on live backend services. The platform supports exact-request matching, configurable responses, dynamic JSON templates, callback simulation, environment variables, and Postman collection imports. Designed the application architecture and developed the backend, dashboard, and API mocking workflows. Implemented configurable request matching, weighted responses, sequential responses, rule-based selection, and fault simulation. Built dynamic response templates, callback configuration, request/callback logs, and version history with comparison and restoration. Developed import/export workflows with previews, variable mapping, credential detection, and sensitive-data masking. Added Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools for automated mock management and Postman imports, including isolated test runs and safe retries. Created automated backend and frontend regression tests, CI checks, and technical documentation.
- Jira Worklog Manager: Built a browser-based personal productivity tool for logging and managing Jira Cloud worklogs, eliminating the friction of Jira's native time-tracking UI with a fast, keyboard-first single-page experience. Designed and implemented a proxy-free React + Vite architecture with a custom month-bucket worklog cache, enabling on-demand data fetching per view instead of a single upfront bulk load — reducing initial API calls significantly. Engineered a real-time work timer that persists across page reloads and browser restarts using localStorage, with a floating chip that survives client-side navigation and pre-fills the log work modal on stop. Implemented advanced worklog operations including bulk logging across multiple issues, worklog splitting with live sum validation, duplicate entry, and a 5-second undo-delete flow with optimistic UI updates. Built a multi-tab summary dashboard featuring a Clockwork-style weekly timesheet grid, GitHub-style heatmap calendar, per-project breakdown chart, logged vs. estimated variance report, and CSV export. Developed a per-issue work notes system backed by the File System Access API for auto-save to a user-chosen file on disk, with graceful fallback to manual export/import on unsupported browsers. Implemented a global command palette with fuzzy issue search, keyboard navigation, and direct Jira key lookup, along with Jira workflow status transitions directly from the issue list.
- Roamly: Travel recommendation and experience-sharing platform for travel enthusiasts. Recommends places, hotels, travel guides, taxi rides, and shops. Includes an experience-sharing platform where travelers can connect and share their stories.
- Micro CAPS: Assembly process management system for Micro Car Limited. Manages vehicle assembly process from chassis delivery to dispatching.

## Core Domains & Representative Stack

Tools and frameworks change; engineering fundamentals endure. Grounded in computer science principles, distributed architecture, and application security, I treat languages and frameworks as interchangeable instruments—adapting rapidly to whatever stack a system requires.

Languages — Object-oriented, functional & systems programming: Java, JavaScript, PHP, C++
Frameworks & Runtimes — RESTful APIs, microservices, SPAs & enterprise CMS: React, Node.js, Spring Boot, Drupal, Yii, Laravel, Symfony
Data & Caching — Relational modeling, document stores & in-memory caching: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis
DevOps & Cloud — Container orchestration, CI/CD pipelines & event streaming: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Kafka
Systems & Quality Tooling — Static analysis, security gates, Linux ops & API testing: Git, Linux, SonarQube, Postman
